scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.start: npm run build && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run start -w server
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build -w client && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema server/prisma/schema.prisma
